title: Jimo Borjigin's research on endogenous DMT and terminal lucidity

tellings.quote: >> Yeah, it's fascinating. GMO Borgagen at University of Michigan. She studies stuff around, you know, endogenous DMT receptors in the brain and stuff, but she also studies terminal lucidity,

plain: A University of Michigan researcher named Jimo Borjigin studies DMT, a powerful psychedelic that the brain may make on its own, and also terminal lucidity, when dying people suddenly become clear-minded again. Michels mentions her work himself, in passing, in a conversation about DMT and what it might reveal.
